title: Make it const-correct
description:
This `Circle` class works on ordinary objects, but the tests use a `const Circle`, and nothing can be called on it: the compiler cannot tell which member functions are safe.

Mark every member function that does **not** change the object as `const`. Leave the one that does change it alone.
hints: Put `const` after the parameter list of every function that only reads members: `double area() const`. The one that assigns to a member stays as it is.
unitTests:
TEST("readers work on a const circle") { const Circle c{ 2.0 }; CHECK_NEAR(c.radius(), 2.0, 1e-9); CHECK_NEAR(c.area(), 12.56636, 1e-5); CHECK_NEAR(c.circumference(), 12.56636, 1e-5); }
TEST("setRadius still works on a normal circle") { Circle c{ 1.0 }; c.setRadius(3.0); CHECK_NEAR(c.radius(), 3.0, 1e-9); }
lessonTitle: this, const Member Functions and Chaining
